message: 信じる対象

name: Melilot
message: 「Your methods are as reckless as ever.」

name: Helena
message: 「How rude. Even I wouldn't drip soy sauce into good whiskey.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm talking about having Azel-san live at Sakura-kun's place.」

name: Helena
message: 「I know that.」
Crossing her legs in the chairwoman's seat, Helena brought a glass filled with amber liquid to her lips.

name: Helena
message: 「It's true that I wanted to renovate the dorms.」

name: Melilot
message: 「What would you have done if... Azel-san had noticed the notice?」

name: Helena
message: 「Even then, I still planned to put her in Synn-chan's house. I have a valid pretext, after all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because Demons are targeting Azel-san, she needs a bodyguard--is that it?」

name: Helena
message: 「Actually, when Synn-chan brought Azel-chan here the other day, I intended to make him take care of her as his punishment.」

name: Melilot
message: 「His behavior is predictable given his personality, after all. Then why didn't you do that?」
Helena wore a delighted expression.

name: Helena
message: 「Because that Azel-chan stood up for Synn-chan and claimed it was her fault. That girl bowing her head of her own accord was completely unexpected.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan is a natural charmer. My eye for people wasn't mistaken. If only he were a rugged middle-aged man... what a shame.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, that alone won't be enough to defeat the Demon Lord.」

name: Helena
message: 「It'll be fine. Probably.」

name: Helena
message: 「You haven't touched your drink at all. Come on, bottom's up!」

name: Melilot
message: 「We're having a serious conversation here.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Why is it that only Azel-san is being targeted, I wonder?」

name: Helena
message: 「There's no mistake that she's an angel, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. The Principality of Sharo-Ma is a common cover story angels use when entering the Human World through official channels, and......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Judging from her words, actions, and reactions, there's almost certainly no doubt.」

name: Helena
message: 「But that doesn't explain why she's the one being targeted, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. There are two angels at this academy. Furthermore, it seems Lolotte-san's friend has also come to Ryuusei Town. Yet she is the only one being targeted.」

name: Helena
message: 「There's probably something unique to her alone.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Separating them to draw that out... You're quite the schemer, aren't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「No, I'm betting on the Student Council President. Thinking that maybe he'll be able to open the door to Azel-chan's heart.」

name: Helena
message: 「Even if she has a secret she can't tell anyone--something that makes her a target for Demons--she might just open up to Synn-chan.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You truly believe in the Demon Lord as always, Helena.」
Helena smiled mischievously.

name: Helena
message: 「Wrong. I believe in our Student Council President.」
